glossary.def: Hosted agent protocol for arbitrary JSON at `/invocations`. You define the schema, manage sessions and write raw SSE. Used for webhooks, batch work and custom streaming.
The protocol for Teams and Microsoft 365 channel delivery. The platform bridges it from Responses when you publish.
A durable key-value store that survives crashes and idle eviction, can be partitioned per end user and ages items out after a 30 day idle window by default.
Preview capability that lets a later process recover long-running work after a crash. Recovery reenters the handler from its beginning, so the handler needs checkpoints and idempotency.
Preview toolbox feature that hides tools by default and exposes `tool_search` and `call_tool`, so large catalogs do not flood the context window.
A resource that combines knowledge sources with retrieval settings and runs on Azure AI Search agentic retrieval. Many agents can share one.
Managed store of long-term memory items in Foundry (preview), scoped per user, with extraction, consolidation and retrieval phases.
Who can see and call a published Foundry agent: Individual (`Shared`, no approval) or Organization (`Tenant`, admin approval).
A Foundry agent that has an agent user account in addition to its agent identity, so it acts as itself in Microsoft 365, including group chats.
The unified inventory of agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center (Agents, All Agents, Registry), part of Agent 365.
The Microsoft program tenants must join to use agent user accounts and Agent 365 notifications while they are in preview.
Foundry surface where you can register a custom agent that runs elsewhere. API Management sits in front as a proxy for access control and monitoring.

claims.text: Foundry Agent Service has three agent types: prompt agents, voice-based prompt agents and hosted agents. Calling the Responses API directly gives an ephemeral agent with no Foundry agent resource.
Tracing is GA for prompt and hosted agents, and preview for workflow and external agents. It stores telemetry in Application Insights.
Voice-based prompt agents are preview. Direct SIP is not offered, and phone numbers come from Teams Phone extensibility or Twilio.
latency_threshold_ms for interim responses in a voice agent defaults to 2000 and the docs advise lowering it.
Support for the initial-preview hosted agent backend ended on 2026-08-20. Redeploy needs azure-ai-projects 2.3.0 or later and azd 1.23.0 or later with the azure.ai.agents extension.
An explicit statement that hosted agents are GA was not found. The GA table has no hosted agent row and the concept page has no preview banner.
Hosted agents can expose Responses, Invocations, Invocations (WebSocket), Activity and A2A. A2A v1.0 is GA and v0.3 is preview.
Hosted agent idle timeout is set per agent version from 2 to 60 minutes with a default of 15.
A hosted agent session is permanently deleted after 30 days of inactivity. `$HOME` and `/files` are persisted on idle and restored on resume.
Hosted sandbox sizes are 0.5 vCPU 1 GiB, 1 vCPU 2 GiB and 2 vCPU 4 GiB, with a disk budget up to 20 GiB at 1 vCPU or larger and about 20 percent reserved.
Resilient recovery reenters the handler from its beginning. It is not deterministic replay and does not restore local variables.
A hosted agent endpoint serves one version with 100 percent of traffic and traffic splitting is not supported. Each version is an immutable snapshot.
Docs advise moving to the next size when sustained peaks pass about 70 percent of allocation. Billing is CPU plus memory across active sessions.
A private Azure Container Registry works only for projects created after 2026-06-25.
Portal publishing is not supported for projects with public network access disabled. Use the REST API with enable_m365_public_endpoint.
A token whose audience is the MCP server URL instead of the downstream resource ID fails even with correct RBAC.

With the Responses API called directly, the agent definition lives in your code, nothing is created in Foundry, and you still get catalog models, platform tools, OBO auth and project-level observability.
A Foundry toolbox exposes one MCP-compatible endpoint with central auth, toolbox-level guardrails and versioning. Promoting a default version needs no agent redeploy.
Function calling, Grounding with Bing, computer use, image generation, SharePoint, Fabric data agent and Azure Functions are direct integration only, not toolbox tools.
Each simultaneous conversation using code interpreter creates its own session, active one hour by default with a 30 minute idle timeout.
The web search tool uses Grounding with Bing. The Microsoft DPA does not apply to data sent to it and transfers occur outside compliance and geographic boundaries.
Whether Logic Apps exists as a built-in tool in the new Agent Service is unverified. It is absent from the toolbox support table.
Foundry IQ retrieval reasoning effort is minimal, low or medium. It syncs ACLs for supported sources, honors Purview sensitivity labels and can query under the caller's Entra identity.
The classic Connected Agents tool is not available in the new Foundry Agent Service. The a2a tool type (A2A 1.0) is GA and a2a_preview (0.3) is preview.

Incoming A2A on a Foundry agent is v1.0 over JSON-RPC only, text only, no streaming, needs the Responses protocol and the Foundry Agent Consumer role, and keeps tasks 60 days. Without a version header it serves 0.3.
Foundry Workflows (preview) retire on 2026-12-01 and classic agents retire on 2027-03-31.
Foundry memory quotas: 100 scopes per store, 10,000 memories per scope, 1,000 search and 1,000 update requests per minute. VNet integration is not supported for memory stores.
Publish scope Shared (Individual) enables BotServiceRbac with no admin approval. Scope Tenant (Organization) enables BotServiceTenant and needs admin approval in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
Publishing needs Azure Bot Service Contributor (or Contributor or Owner) plus Foundry User, and the Microsoft.BotService resource provider. Foundry roles do not grant bot write permissions.
The agent optimizer is limited preview, ranks candidates by a composite score from 0.0 to 1.0 and invokes the agent on every dataset task, so tools execute during evaluation.
The Agent 365 Observability SDK is deprecated for new work. The Microsoft OpenTelemetry Distro replaces it for .NET, Node.js and Python.
An Entra agent identity is a service principal with servicePrincipalType ServiceIdentity and no credentials. The blueprint holds the credentials.
Every blueprint and agent identity needs at least one sponsor. Sponsors cannot edit auth settings or re-enable. Owners are optional, are never groups and can re-enable or hard-delete.
In OBO the user is the token subject and the agent identity is the actor. In S2S the agent identity is the subject. Agentic-User needs the Frontier preview.
An autopilot is a Foundry agent with an Entra agent user account in addition to its agent identity. Only the agent user lets it act as itself in Microsoft 365.
Agent 365 became generally available on 2026-05-01 for the Commercial segment on a per-user basis. A numeric price was not verified.
The Agent 365 SDK adds identity, governed tooling and notifications. It does not build, host, orchestrate or run tools.
The Agent 365 registry has four types and its summary shows total agents, agents without owners and unmanaged agents. One Copilot Studio agent can appear in more than one type by design.
Creating an agent instance for Agent 365 automatically enables Purview audit, data classification and Compliance Manager AI regulation assessments. Other Purview capabilities need policies.

Without the Microsoft 365 connector, Copilot Studio real-time protection still blocks but alerts do not appear in Defender. Local agents are onboarded separately through Defender for Endpoint in active mode.
